title: Session signal adaptor and ergonomic generator wrappers with SDK version sync
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: reduce repetitive session handshake and streaming boilerplate across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs while giving consumers an ergonomic generator/streaming experience. This change introduces a lightweight session signal adaptor concept and idiomatic wrappers for each SDK plus a compact shared retry preset to make streaming auth/retries predictable and tunable. The adaptor surfaces heartbeat, reauth_hint, chunk, and end signals so users can handle token rotation and graceful shutdown without erroring the stream by default. Changes include language native shims, tests, docs, and synchronized package version bumps for downstream stability.

review_conversation: Jordan Lin: Can you clarify how the Python generator will behave on partial chunk errors? Asha Kapoor: The generator yields an intermediate chunk event with an error flag for partial failures and only emits a reauth_hint event for 401/419 so consumers choose whether to stop or continue; we avoid raising inside the generator to preserve ergonomic consumption. Priya Mehta: TS discriminated union looks fine but add a typed guard helper for reauth events. Asha: Added isReauthEvent typed guard and unit test. Evan Zhou: Observed a CI flake in the canary fixture, suggest bumping timeouts. Asha: Increased fixture timeouts and adjusted retry presets, CI rerun passed. Reviewers approved and requested a squash merge.
release_notes: Add: session signal adaptor primitives for Python, TypeScript, and Go to simplify streaming auth and heartbeat handling.
Add: compact retry profile preset for streaming clients with sensible defaults and tunables.
Change: synchronize SDK package versions to py 1.5.0, ts 2.3.1, go 1.8.0.
Fix: CI fixture timeouts and related flakes.
summary: Introduce cross-SDK session signal adaptors and ergonomic generator wrappers, consolidate streaming retry presets, and align SDK versions.
